diff --git a/outlines/types/__init__.py b/outlines/types/__init__.py
index 85af9adc..7be854b5 100644
--- a/outlines/types/__init__.py
+++ b/outlines/types/__init__.py
@@ -59,6 +59,29 @@ email = Regex(
     r"""(?:[a-z0-9!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+)*|"(?:[\x01-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x21\x23-\x5b\x5d-\x7f]|\\[\x01-\x09\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x7f])*")@(?:(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?|\[(?:(?:(2(5[0-5]|[0-4][0-9])|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9]))\.){3}(?:(2(5[0-5]|[0-4][0-9])|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])|[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]:(?:[\x01-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x21-\x5a\x53-\x7f]|\\[\x01-\x09\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x7f])+)\])"""
 )
 
+# Matches web URLs that use the http or https scheme, in the form
+# scheme://[userinfo@]host[:port][/path][?query][#fragment]. The host is a
+# domain name with at least one dot and an alphabetic top-level domain (so
+# short ones like a.co work and a bare "example" does not), an IPv4 address
+# with octets up to 255, a bracketed IPv6 address, or localhost. Path, query
+# and fragment accept any character but whitespace, quotes, angle brackets and
+# backslashes, which cannot appear in a URL and would break a JSON string.
+url = Regex(
+    r"https?://"
+    r"(?:[a-zA-Z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=-]+(?::[a-zA-Z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=:-]*)?@)?"
+    r"(?:"
+    r"(?:[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9]"
+    r"|(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}"
+    r"(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])"
+    r"|\[(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{0,4}:){2,7}[0-9a-fA-F]{0,4}\]"
+    r"|localhost"
+    r")"
+    r"(?::[0-9]{1,5})?"
+    r'(?:/[^\s"<>\\?#]*)?'
+    r'(?:\?[^\s"<>\\#]*)?'
+    r'(?:#[^\s"<>\\]*)?'
+)
+
 # Matches any ISBN number. Note that this is not completely correct as not all
 # 10 or 13 digits numbers are valid ISBNs. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISBN
 # Taken from O'Reilly's Regular Expression Cookbook:
@@ -68,3 +91,13 @@ email = Regex(
 isbn = Regex(
     r"(?:ISBN(?:-1[03])?:? )?(?=[0-9X]{10}$|(?=(?:[0-9]+[- ]){3})[- 0-9X]{13}$|97[89][0-9]{10}$|(?=(?:[0-9]+[- ]){4})[- 0-9]{17}$)(?:97[89][- ]?)?[0-9]{1,5}[- ]?[0-9]+[- ]?[0-9]+[- ]?[0-9X]"
 )
+
+# Matches a 16-digit credit card number written as four groups of four digits.
+# The groups are either run together, or all separated by a space, or all
+# separated by a hyphen; a number that mixes separators does not match. The
+# three layouts are spelled out because a back-reference to the first
+# separator is not available in the regular expressions outlines supports.
+# This checks the format only, not the Luhn check digit or the card issuer.
+credit_card = Regex(
+    r"([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}|[0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4}|[0-9]{16})"
+)
